messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Alert ALRT-842 fired for service model-serving-us-central. Trigger: 5xx errors > 1% and p95 latency > 3s for 4m. Priority: P1. Primary on-call: lauren. Escalation policy: 8m -> secondary (josh) -> manager (carol).

lauren: Im away from keyboard for another 6 mins, will try to ack ASAP. tagging @ops-sre if someone can start looking?

incident-bot: New incident thread created: #incidents/2662345678. Runbooks: runbooks/serving_latency.md. Please post updates here.

emma: Customer support: getting multiple complaints from NimbusPay and Lattice about slow completions/timeouts around 20-30s. Raising priority on comms.

josh: (auto-escalation) PagerDuty escalated to secondary after 8m without ack. Im taking the incident and acknowledging.

josh: Acked ALRT-842. Quick pulse check: frontend error surge matches backend token generation failing with Redis timeouts on cache-pop. No obvious CPU/GPU pressure.

nikhil: pulling logs from serving nodes. I see repeated socket timeouts to redis-cache-0, then falling back to disk read which increases latency. Network path between compute and cache shows increased RTT. Starting packet capture on host.

josh: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily throttle non-critical customers to reduce load 2) shift VIP for critical customers to us-east1 3) spin up additional redis replica and promote if stable. Doing step 2 now as canary.

josh: executing traffic move for high-tier tenants:
```
redwoodctl routing move --service model-serving --from us-central --to us-east1 --tenants high_priority --reason "emergency cache latency"
```

lauren: back at desk, thanks for stepping in josh. Ill own the post-incident writeup after stabilization.

incident-bot: Note: auto-escalation to manager scheduled at 2662345480 if unresolved.

carol: (manager escalation) Notified via PD due to customer impact. Im standing by to help with customer comms. Assigning manager liaison: carol.

nikhil: packet capture shows repeated ARP storms on vlan 43 between app-subnet and cache-subnet. Looks like a bad NIC on host redis-cache-0. Im draining redis-cache-0 and bringing up replica-05 in us-central.

josh: replica added and promotion queued. Running rolling restart of redis on that rack. Commands:
```
kubectl cordon node redis-cache-0
kubectl drain node redis-cache-0 --ignore-daemonsets
redis-cli --replicate-to replica-05
```

emma: NimbusPay confirms reduced errors after VIP shift; Lattice still seeing some slow tails but much improved. Sending templated update to affected customers.

ops-sre: tagging network team for physical host NIC replacement and switch logs. Suspect flapping.

josh: after reroute, p95 for high-tier tenants dropped from ~4.2s to 1.1s within 45s. Overall error rate halved. Continuing monitoring for 30m.

incident-bot: PD alert ALRT-842 acknowledged by josh. Manager escalation recorded at 2662345520. Escalation timer suspended while acknowledged.

lauren: initial impact summary for handoff: root cause likely failed NIC on cache host -> increased cache misses and disk fallbacks -> elevated generation latency and some 5xx. Mitigations: VIP reroute for critical tenants, added/promoted replica, drained faulty host, notified network for hardware replacement. Customers affected: NimbusPay (mostly mitigated), Lattice (partial). Estimated affected requests ~1.8% over 22 minutes.

carol: good containment. Please add: follow-ups - replace NIC & switch port, extend cache-miss alerting to 10s window, test routing fallback playbook during next on-call drill. Ill draft external customer note for Lattice follow-up.

nikhil: filing infra ticket INF-9007 for host replacement and attaching tcpdump and switch logs.

josh: handing over to lauren for post-incident. Ill keep watch on monitoring for next 30m before closing my loop.

incident-bot: On-call handoff: primary on-call changed to lauren at 2662345800. Incident state: stabilized.

lauren: drafting postmortem ticket 266234-pm-2 with timeline and telemetry. Will include exact affected request counts and timestamps.

pagerduty-bot: ALRT-842 marked stabilized by josh. If no recurrence within 45 minutes, PD will auto-resolve.

ops-sre: good job everyone. Reminder to keep playbook docs up to date: runbooks/serving_latency.md needs an update for ARP/flapping cases. :clap:
